target_customer: Hardware startups needing sheet metal, tube and CNC parts in prototype and small batch
problem: Fast-moving hardware teams wait on slow quotes and long lead times from traditional machine shops.
business_model: Contract manufacturing with instant online quoting, revenue per part
product_category: Software-defined contract manufacturing, sheet metal fabrication

founders.name: Kenneth Cassel
founders.background_notes: YC page: became a parent at 20, worked in the trades for nearly a decade, then software engineer for a few years. No employers or education named.

competitors.name: Xometry
competitors.what: on-demand manufacturing marketplace including sheet metal
competitors.funding_then: 50 million equity round in 2019, 75 million in 2020

competitors.name: Fictiv
competitors.funding_then: 35 million Series D in February 2021, 92.6 million total

competitors.name: Protolabs
competitors.what: public on-demand manufacturer with in-house factories, added sheet metal in 2017

technical_complexity.rationale: Quoting and DFM software is standard, but running a physical factory with lasers, brakes and welding adds capital and operations difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: Contract fabrication is a crowded, capital-heavy commodity service; advantage rests on speed and software automation that rivals like SendCutSend and Xometry also pursue.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent acquiring or copying RMFG. Established online fabricators already offered instant quotes.

market_need_then: Hardware startups needed quick small-batch metal parts; online manufacturing platforms had raised large rounds by 2019 to 2021, showing spend.

branding.domain_note: Uses rmfg.com; acquisition history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: plain, speed-focused (ships in as few as two days)

branding.community_and_virality: Business Insider ran a story on the founder's pitch deck, a press item about the founder more than the brand.

brand_strength.rationale: Name origin and logo not found. Customer logo wall on the site shows hardware startup adoption, but little brand press.

outcome_analysis: RMFG is a Fort Worth sheet metal factory run by a founder with a trades and software background, accepted into YC Summer 2021. Public funding is a reported 4.5 million round in December 2025, four years after the batch, which suggests slow capital-light growth. It serves hardware startups and remains active; no exit or shutdown found.
notes: The December 2025 round is labelled seed by Seedtable and Business Insider headline, pre-seed by CB Insights, Caplight and VCBacked; recorded as seed with this conflict noted. One outlet says Y Combinator led, others only list it. CB Insights lists 5M total over 3 rounds, so earlier rounds may exist; not found. Founding year conflicts: 2021 (YC, CB Insights), 2023, 2024 in other aggregators. Outcome search found no acquisition, shutdown or layoffs. Business Insider article was seen only through syndicated search snippets. Competitors are marketplace and online manufacturers dated 2020 to 2021; SendCutSend is a likely rival but no dated source was found.
